text: Overnight, Gavin Newsom's price climbed 0.7 points to 11.4, the largest change on the board. Most of that came on Kalshi, which moved 1.0 point, while Polymarket went the same way by 0.5 points. The odds that Abdul El-Sayed enters the race fell 18 points on Kalshi, to 10 percent, even though El-Sayed's nomination price barely moved. Our simulations hardly noticed; Newsom still wins 21 percent of them. The markets have Jon Ossoff on top at 27. In our simulations it's AOC, first in 28 percent of runs. About 11 in 100 simulated primaries end without a pledged majority, which sends the fight to the convention floor. Tonight's prices will show whether the Newsom move holds.
